    The brick hypothesis for k(Γ_A) #

    Lemma 5.2 (the deletion brick lemma) for C = k(Γ_A): by Proposition 2.10, C satisfies the hypotheses of the abstract statement CatAlg.MeshData.brick (labels outside Σ of least evaluation dimension have their radical endomorphisms factoring through Σ). In the object quotient C/[Σ] the kernel on C(x, y) is the span of composites through objects of Σ; hence such a label has endomorphism ring k in C/[Σ].

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.ScalarMeshCategory.objectQuotient_map_eq_zero_iff {k : Type u} [Field k] {V : Type} [Quiver V] [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] {Q : TranslationQuiver V} [(x : V) → Fintype ((y : V) × (y ⟶ x))] (c : MeshCoefficients k Q) (D : Set V) {x y : V} (f : obj c x ⟶ obj c y) :
    (RelationCategory.functor k (identityRelations c D)).map f = 0 ↔ f ∈ CatAlg.MeshData.through (fun (x : V) => obj c x) D x y

    The kernel of C → C/[D] is the span of the composites through D.

    BrickHypothesis c

    The brick hypothesis follows from Lemma 5.2 in the form of CatAlg.MeshData.brick.
